mapper.select: select count(*) as known_events, count(distinct ie.phrase_id) as unique_phrases, count(distinct ps.slug) as covered_space_count, min(client_timestamp) as first_event_at from interaction_events ie left join practice_activities pa on pa.slug = ie.activity_id left join practice_spaces ps on ps.id = pa.space_id where ie.account_id = #{accountId}

select distinct date(client_timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') as practice_date from interaction_events where account_id = #{accountId} and client_timestamp >= cast(#{todayStart} as timestamp with time zone) - interval '365 days' order by practice_date desc

select achieved_at from ( select min(ie.client_timestamp) as achieved_at, row_number() over (order by min(ie.client_timestamp)) as rn from interaction_events ie join practice_activities pa on pa.slug = ie.activity_id join practice_spaces ps on ps.id = pa.space_id where ie.account_id = #{accountId} group by ps.slug ) sub where rn = 3
select client_timestamp from interaction_events where account_id = #{accountId} order by client_timestamp asc offset 49 limit 1

select ie.event_key from interaction_events ie where ie.account_id = #{accountId} and not exists ( select 1 from garden_fertilizer_claim_log gfcl where gfcl.user_id = ie.account_id and gfcl.event_key = ie.event_key ) order by ie.client_timestamp desc limit 20
